workspace.add.title: Add a workspace
workspace.add.lead: Create a new workspace, or get into one that already exists.
workspace.add.createLead: Opens a new workspace on this server. Only the server operator can create one.
workspace.add.createLeadNotOperator: Only this server's operator can create one. This account can't.
workspace.add.joinLead: Use an address or an invite link. For now this signs you out and continues on the sign-in screen.
workspace.add.joinHint: Paste it as you received it. For example: https://team.example.com
workspace.add.joinEmpty: Enter an address or an invite link.
workspace.add.joinClaim: First-owner and reset links can't be used here. Sign out and paste it on the sign-in screen.
workspace.add.joinSameServer: You're already on this server. For another workspace on it, sign out and use “Sign in to another workspace” on the sign-in screen with its workspace ID.
workspace.add.joinUnreachable: Couldn't reach {server}, so you weren't signed out. Check the address.
workspace.add.joinConfirmBody: This app signs in to one workspace at a time. You'll be signed out of this workspace. The sign-in screen will be filled in with what you entered.
workspace.add.joinTargetServer: Continues on the sign-in screen of {server}.
workspace.add.joinTargetInviteOnly: Continues with the invite link you received.
workspace.add.joinOpenBody: On the web you can't switch to another server from this window. That server opens in a new tab, and this workspace stays as it is.
workspace.add.joinOpenServer: Opens the sign-in screen of {server} in a new tab.
workspace.add.joinOpenInvite: Opens the invite to {server} in a new tab.
workspace.add.joinBadScheme: Only http or https addresses can be opened.
workspace.add.operatorContact: If you have an invite, use “Join one that already exists”. Otherwise, ask the person who runs this server.
workspace.create.lead: Adds another workspace on this server. Whoever creates it becomes the owner, and it starts with a single #general channel. Only the server operator can create one.
workspace.create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only. It must be unique on the whole server.
workspace.create.operatorOnly: Only this server's operator can create a new workspace.
workspace.menu.copyAddressNote: A non-default workspace needs its ID too.
workspace.leave.title: Leave {name}?
workspace.leave.body: Your membership ends and you're signed out right away. Messages you sent stay. You'll need an invite to come back.
workspace.leave.lastOwner: The last owner can't leave. Make someone else an owner first.
workspace.leave.lastOwnerNext: In the Members tab, open that person's profile and change their role to owner, then leave again.
